scenarios.description: Executes GetClientLinksOp successfully when GetClientLinksStep returns return code on0Do, routing to end while preserving operation flow and dependency injection.
inputs: Valid GetClientLinksRequestXml for a client with configured links
dependency_setup: GetClientLinksStep injected via constructor and returns return code 0
DataSource returns a valid Connection configured on OperationContext
NoLinksFoundStep, DatabaseErrorStep, and TechnicalErrorStep are injected via constructor
scenarios.expected_outcome: GetClientLinksResponse XML string formatted via GetClientLinksRSFmtMapper containing the loaded client links
expected_side_effects: GetClientLinksStep.execute is invoked with the operation context
Client links are retrieved from context and transformed into DTOs for the response mapper

scenarios.description: Executes GetClientLinksOp when no links are found (on4Do), routing through NoLinksFound step to end while preserving operation flow and dependency injection.
inputs: Valid GetClientLinksRequestXml for a client without configured links
dependency_setup: GetClientLinksStep injected via constructor and returns return code 4
NoLinksFoundStep injected via constructor executes and populates error category and number
scenarios.expected_outcome: Standard error reply XML string formatted via StandardErrorRSFmtMapper indicating no links found
expected_side_effects: NoLinksFoundStep.execute is invoked on the context
Error fields are retrieved from context for the error reply

scenarios.description: Executes GetClientLinksOp when a database error occurs (on8Do), routing through DatabaseError step to end while preserving operation flow and dependency injection.
inputs: Valid GetClientLinksRequestXml triggering a database condition
dependency_setup: GetClientLinksStep injected via constructor and returns return code 8
DatabaseErrorStep injected via constructor executes and sets error details in context
scenarios.expected_outcome: Standard error reply XML string formatted via StandardErrorRSFmtMapper for database error
expected_side_effects: DatabaseErrorStep.execute is invoked on the context
Error details are written to context and rendered into the error reply

scenarios.description: Executes GetClientLinksOp when an unexpected return code occurs (onOtherDo), routing through TechnicalError step to end while preserving operation flow and dependency injection.
inputs: Valid GetClientLinksRequestXml resulting in an unexpected error code
dependency_setup: GetClientLinksStep injected via constructor and returns an unexpected return code
TechnicalErrorStep injected via constructor executes and sets technical error details in context
scenarios.expected_outcome: Standard error reply XML string formatted via StandardErrorRSFmtMapper for technical error
expected_side_effects: TechnicalErrorStep.execute is invoked on the context
Technical error category and number are assigned to the error reply
